name: 8-carboxamidocyclazocine
summary: 8-Carboxamidocyclazocine (8-CAC) is an opioid analgesic drug related to cyclazocine, discovered by medicinal chemist Mark P. Wentland and co-workers in Cogswell Laboratory at Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute. Similarly to cyclazocine, 8-CAC acts as an agonist at both the μ- and κ-opioid receptors, but has a much longer duration of action than cyclazocine, and does not have μ antagonist activity.

pharmacology.text: Unexpectedly, it was discovered that the phenolic hydroxyl group of cyclazocine could be replaced by a carboxamido group with only slight loss of potency at opioid receptors, and this discovery has subsequently been used to develop many novel opioid derivatives where the phenolic hydroxy group has been replaced by either carboxamide or a variety of larger groups.

summaryZh: 8-氨甲醯基環佐辛是一種含氮有機化合物，分子式C19H26N2O，屬於環佐辛衍生物，可作為類阿片鎮痛藥，由倫斯勒理工學院的Mark P. Wentland等人研發。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. It acts on both μ- and κ-opioid receptors. Drugs acting on the κ receptor can cause dysphoria, dizziness and strange perceptual effects, while μ action brings drowsiness, nausea and slowed breathing.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。它同時作用於μ與κ鴉片受體。作用於κ受體的藥物可能引起情緒惡劣、頭暈與奇特的知覺變化，而μ受體的作用則帶來嗜睡、噁心與呼吸變慢。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。它同时作用于μ与κ鸦片受体。作用于κ受体的药物可能引起情绪恶劣、头晕与奇特的知觉变化，而μ受体的作用则带来嗜睡、恶心与呼吸变慢。

fact.en: It came from a surprising finding: the phenol group that opioid chemists had long thought essential could be swapped for an amide group with only a small loss of potency.
fact.zh: 它源自一項意外的發現：鴉片類化學家長久以來認為不可或缺的酚基，其實可以換成醯胺基，而效力只稍微下降。
fact.zhHans: 它源自一项意外的发现：鸦片类化学家长久以来认为不可或缺的酚基，其实可以换成酰胺基，而效力只稍微下降。
